sources.title: ETOPO 2022 60 arc-second surface elevation (Global Relief Model)
sources.licence: public domain (US government work, NOAA NCEI)
sources.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (2022), ETOPO 2022 60 Arc-Second Global Relief Model, doi:10.25921/fd45-gt74
sources.note: OPeNDAP subsets at stride 2 (every second 60″ cell, about 3.7 km), 5 bands either side of 180° stitched into one grid (75.8 MB); each cell binned into the texel its centre projects to, weighted by cos φ, land and sea cells apart; heights only: land is decided by Natural Earth; sea never shallower than −1 m

sources.title: Natural Earth 10 m physical vectors: land, minor islands, reefs, coastline, minor islands coastline
sources.note: decides the table’s land: a texel is land where the land and minor-island polygons cover at least half of it (4 × 4 samples a texel); coast.json carries the polygons (clipped to the envelope, merged at 180°, simplified) and the coastline strokes; no Natural Earth name is used
